summary: Iteration 119 regression pass on the final 11 SELECT * -> explicit column list trim and the 3-phase super_admin.create_org_user transaction restructuring. Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_iter119_select_star_trim_p3.py: 21/21 passing (54.87s). Coverage: (1) GET /api/meetings/{id} — asserted every _DETAIL_COLS field is returned (id, org_id, title, date, location, meeting_type, created_by, sign_off_manager_*, attendees, team_id, setting_id, status, analysis_id, transcript_id, transcript_has_warnings, shared_with, pii_redactions, sign_off_record, reopen_record, rescan_status, reopen_requested, created_at, updated_at) plus nested transcript.speaker_text/speaker_colors/safety_warnings and analysis.actions/risks/cqc_mappings/care_cert_mappings/custom_mappings/achievements/learning_needs — all present on the in_review test meeting. Also verified against a signed_off meeting. (2) GET /api/review/{id} — verified flat shape carries every meeting-level field the report page reads (attendees, sign_off_record, reopen_record, pii_redactions, transcript_has_warnings, rescan_status, reopen_requested) plus transcript/analysis/comments blocks. (3) GET /api/review/{id}/export-pdf — 200 with real application/pdf payload (>1KB, starts with %PDF), both with include_transcript=false and =true, on a signed_off meeting (Maria Santos past-2). This is the query whose column list was hand-trimmed to only what _generate_pdf reads (title,date,status,transcript_id,analysis_id,pii_redactions,attendees,shared_with,created_by,sign_off_manager_id,sign_off_manager_name,sign_off_record + analyses.summary/edited_summary/achievements/actions/learning_needs/risks/cqc_mappings/care_cert_mappings/custom_mappings) — PDF still generates successfully so no needed column was missed. (4) GET /api/review/{id}/export-transcript regression — 200/400/404 accepted, never 500, no column errors. (5) GET /api/portfolio/{user_id} — verified user block returns name/email/role for admin viewing self, admin viewing an attendee, and attendee viewing self. Underlying users trim (id, org_id, name, email, role, team_id, setting_id) safely resolves. (6) GET /api/doc-uploads/{upload_id} — verified all fields (id,label,filename,staff_name,meeting_date,uploader_name,status,cqc_mappings,care_cert_mappings,custom_mappings) on a 'done' upload; 404 for nonexistent id. (7) GET /api/prep/{meeting_id} — verified exists=true response carries sections, focus_topic, shared_with_attendees, gen_status, included_source_ids, coverage_results on a completed prep record. (8) POST /api/super-admin/orgs/{org_id}/users — full 3-phase happy path: 201 response contains id/email/name/role/org_id; DB shows supabase_migrated=TRUE and supabase_password_set=TRUE (Phase 3 flag flip after Phase 2 Supabase Auth calls); newly created user can immediately log in with the given password (Phase 2 set_password succeeded). Also verified 404 org-not-found and 400 duplicate-email guards still fire correctly (BEFORE any Supabase network call). (9) Smoke: /auth/me, /meetings (admin + manager), /admin/users all 200. Frontend smoke via Playwright: admin login → /meetings/{in_review_id}/report renders Overview tab with Meeting Summary text, Action Items panel, Learning Needs panel, Review Status; tab bar shows Overview/Transcript/Compliance/Comments (2)/Prep Agenda/Audit Trail. /meetings/{signed_off_id}/report renders with Signed Off badge, summary text, both attendees showing 'Signed Off', 'Send to Attendees' + Re-open request buttons. No page-error events fired, only harmless pre-login 401 /auth/me. Backend logs during entire run: NO new 'column does not exist' errors, only 7 pre-existing historical 'outcomes' errors from 10:57-10:59 (before this session's restart). Conclusion: all 11 trimmed queries and the create_org_user restructuring are fully non-regressive.
action_items: None — 21/21 pytest pass. The final 11 SELECT * -> explicit column trim (meetings.py get_meeting, review.py get_review_data + export_pdf, portfolio.py _build_portfolio_data, doc_uploads.py get_upload, prep.py get_prep) is fully non-regressive. The super_admin.create_org_user 3-phase transaction restructuring works end-to-end: insert commits, Supabase Auth calls fire outside any transaction, follow-up flag UPDATE commits, and the created user can log in immediately with supabase_migrated=TRUE + supabase_password_set=TRUE.
critical_code_review_comments: review.py export_pdf hand-trimmed column list is correct — cross-verified _generate_pdf's actual field accesses (title/date/status/pii_redactions/attendees/shared_with/created_by/sign_off_manager_id/sign_off_manager_name/sign_off_record on meetings; summary/edited_summary/achievements/actions/learning_needs/risks/cqc_mappings/care_cert_mappings/custom_mappings on analyses). PDF still generates with correct content on signed-off meeting (>10KB payload).

meetings.py _DETAIL_COLS and review.py _MEETING_DETAIL_COLS are IDENTICAL 47-column strings — worth extracting to a shared constant in a helper module (e.g., `utils/columns.py`) to avoid future drift where a new column is added to one but not the other. Non-blocking.

super_admin.create_org_user Phase 2 exception handling swallows Supabase errors (just logs.error and skips flag update) — user gets created locally but stays on bcrypt fallback. This is by design (per the code comment), but worth noting that no retry mechanism exists — an admin would have to manually retry via a separate flow if Supabase provisioning fails. Consider adding a retry/reconciliation cron.
portfolio.py _build_portfolio_data column trim safely omits password_hash / mfa_* / supabase_* etc. — no privacy regression.
